body.title: Implement the tailLogWith core + LogFilter predicate + logCategories/tailLog facade wrappers
body.summary: In src/cli/services/debug.ts add: (a) logCategories() returning the two static categories (daemon->stem 'daemon', agent->stem 'agent'); (b) tailLogWith(deps) over an injectable fs seam { listSegments(stem), readTail(file,maxLines), watch(file,cb)->unwatch } — resolves the active `<stem>.<N>.<ext>` segment (highest-N/newest-mtime), emits its last-N lines, fs.watch-follows appends, re-resolves+follows across a rotation (lc2), parses each line best-effort into a LogLine (pino JSON → level/module/msg; non-JSON → raw only), a `disposed` guard suppresses post-dispose emits, never throws (empty/missing dir → empty emit); (c) a pure matchesFilter(line, filter) predicate (minLevel>=, module ci-match, text ci-substring over raw; unset=no constraint; ANDed; non-JSON dropped by an active level/module filter); (d) zero-arg facade wrappers logCategories()/tailLog() over realDeps bound to node:fs (readdirSync/readFileSync/watch); bind both onto the makeServices() debug entry. Build note: land WITH t3 (the fakes) in one increment.
acceptanceChecks: logCategories() returns exactly [daemon, agent] and opens no stream
tailLogWith resolves the active segment + emits its last-N lines on start; a watch 'change' emits appended lines; a newer higher-N segment appearing re-resolves+follows it (lc2)
tailLogWith parses pino JSON into level/module/msg and a non-JSON line into raw-only; an empty/missing dir emits [] and never throws; a readTail/watch throw is swallowed (subscription survives)
dispose() removes the watcher and suppresses any post-dispose onLines emit (idempotent)
matchesFilter honours minLevel/module/text (ANDed, unset=no constraint; non-JSON dropped under an active level/module filter, still matched by text via raw)
makeServices().debug.logCategories + .tailLog are bound to the real impls; no real fs.watch/disk in unit tests (deps injected); tsc compiles

tests.name: tailLogWith: resolves the active segment (highest-N/newest-mtime) and emits its last-N lines on start
tailLogWith: a watch 'change' event emits the newly-appended lines (live follow)
tailLogWith: a newer higher-N segment appearing re-resolves+follows it and emits its lines (rotation follow, lc2)
tailLogWith: non-JSON/partial line -> LogLine raw-only; valid pino JSON -> time/level/module/msg
tailLogWith: empty/missing dir or no segment emits [] and never throws (k4)
tailLogWith: a readTail/watch throw is swallowed and the subscription survives
tailLogWith: dispose() removes the watcher and suppresses any post-dispose onLines emit (idempotent)
matchesFilter: minLevel keeps level>=; a non-JSON (no level) line is dropped under an active minLevel
matchesFilter: module ci-match on LogLine.module; text ci-substring over LogLine.raw
matchesFilter: unset fields impose no constraint; level+module+text are ANDed
matchesFilter: free-text still matches a non-JSON line via raw (level/module cannot)
logCategories() returns exactly [daemon, agent] and opens no stream
makeServices().debug exposes logCategories + tailLog bound to the real impls
